userRequest: 就按这个方案修改现有原型和代码，支持直接跟进和按模板流转，由分类控制是否允许直接跟进，同步更新需求记录和产品规格，保留已有功能和字段引用，完成后再审计并修复发现的问题。
scope: explicit handling mode across category, import, assignment, calls, followup, archival, optional flow activation and current product specifications
rules: allowDirectFollowup is an explicit category boolean; absent remains false without read-time migration
handlingMode DIRECT or TEMPLATE is explicit for the entire import; absent preserves TEMPLATE
direct imports keep system/category required fields, types, options, mappings and identity uniqueness; routing-only dependencies are not import requirements in DIRECT
DIRECT has no template instance, workflow run or node; it uses the same business ledger and record identity
direct method must be explicit AI/MANUAL/PREDICTIVE, AI scene must be valid; assignment selects responsibility and required AI arrangement, not professional task resources
direct calls share contact policy, same-number coordination, exact handlers, current values, immutable followup and call facts, idempotency and unknown-result handling
enableFlow is a separate explicit operation on the existing record after execution and required archival converge; current route and entry data are revalidated
prior direct evidence cannot fulfill a new template CALL, and enabling flow cannot leave a second direct execution entry
no automatic downgrade, no repeated import for activation, no fabricated flow completion, no new cross-tenant transfer bypass
preserve existing template and professional capabilities, stable field references and current browser data; no old planning compatibility work or formal approval claims
local finite Mock only; no real CTI, supplier execution, authentication, finance or external service mutations
